name: Backstreet Guile
title: Jahoda: Backstreet Guile
in_play_description: When Jahoda switches to the active character, if the number of cards in your opponent's Hand is greater than or equal to yours, randomly copy 2 cards from their Hand. (Once per Round)

attributes.source: Reward for inviting Jahoda to a duel at The Cat's Tail and achieving all corresponding challenge objectives

skills.desc:
Combat Action: When your active character is Jahoda, equip this card.
After Jahoda equips this card, immediately use Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils once.
When Jahoda switches to the active character, if the number of cards in your opponent's Hand is greater than or equal to yours, randomly copy 2 cards from their Hand. (Once per Round)
(You must have Jahoda in your deck to add this card to your deck.)
